name: Magic Weapon Focus
body:
You become more effective with magic weapons.

Prerequisite(s): Magic item skill class feature, Weapon Focus (any weapon), BAB +1.

Benefit(s): Your Weapon Focus feat applies to any magic weapon you are proficient with.
